points.title: Get answered with AccessAckData, no error
points.condition: A D beat is taken for a data Get (intg_flip=0, instr=0) with o_d_opcode=1 and o_d_error=0.

points.title: PutFullData acknowledged with AccessAck
points.condition: A D beat is taken for a PutFullData (size 2, mask 1111, intg_flip=0) with o_d_opcode=0 and o_d_error=0.

points.title: PutPartialData full-word write succeeds
points.condition: A D beat is taken for a PutPartialData with size 2 and mask 1111 (intg_flip=0) with o_d_opcode=0 and o_d_error=0.

points.title: Byte write to 1-bit register INTR_ENABLE0
points.condition: A PutPartialData with size 0 and mask 0001 to address 0x100 is accepted.

points.title: Byte write to wide register returns error
points.condition: A D beat is taken for a PutPartialData with size 0 at a lane-0 aligned address of a 32-bit register 0x110..0x11C with o_d_error=1.

points.title: Get to unmapped offset accepted
points.condition: A full-word Get (intg_flip=0, instr=0) to a word-aligned address in 0x120..0x1FC is accepted.

points.title: Write to unmapped offset accepted
points.condition: A full-word write (opcode 0 or 1, size 2, mask 1111, intg_flip=0) to a word-aligned address in 0x120..0x1FC is accepted.

points.title: Unmapped access answered with d_error
points.condition: A D beat is taken for a full-word access (size 2, aligned, intg_flip=0, instr=0) to address 0x120..0x1FC with o_d_error=1.

points.title: Illegal opcode request
points.condition: A request with i_a_opcode not 0, 1 or 4 (intg_flip=0) is accepted.

points.title: Illegal size 3 request
points.condition: A request with i_a_size=3 and intg_flip=0 is accepted.

points.title: Misaligned address request
points.condition: A request (intg_flip=0) with size 1 and odd address, or size 2 and address[1:0]!=0, is accepted.

points.title: PutFullData with incomplete mask
points.condition: A PutFullData with size 2 and mask other than 1111 (intg_flip=0) is accepted.

points.title: Byte read at lane 0 of a mapped register
points.condition: A Get with size 0 and address[1:0]=0 to a mapped word is accepted (intg_flip=0, instr=0).

points.title: Byte read at lane 3 of a mapped register
points.condition: A Get with size 0 and address[1:0]=3 to a mapped word is accepted (intg_flip=0, instr=0).

points.title: Half-word read of upper half
points.condition: A Get with size 1 and address[1:0]=2 to a mapped word is accepted (intg_flip=0, instr=0).

points.title: Instruction-fetch Get
points.condition: A Get with i_a_instr=1 is accepted.

points.title: Corrupted A-channel integrity request
points.condition: A request with i_a_intg_flip=1 is accepted.

points.title: Alert pulse without integrity fault
points.condition: o_alert=1 while no request with i_a_intg_flip=1 has been accepted since reset.

points.title: Repeated alert after integrity fault
points.condition: o_alert=1 as at least the second pulse after a request with i_a_intg_flip=1 was accepted.

points.title: ALERT_TEST fatal_fault write while regwen set
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x000 with data[0]=1 and data[31]=1 is accepted before any regwen-clearing write.

points.title: Write 0 to regwen
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x000 with data[31]=0 is accepted.

points.title: Alert test write after regwen cleared
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x000 with data[0]=1 is accepted after a regwen-clearing write since reset.

points.title: Full-word Get of ALERT_TEST and CTRL
points.condition: A full-word Get to 0x000 or 0x004 is accepted.

points.title: Full-word Get of interrupt, config, timer and compare registers
points.condition: A full-word Get to an address in 0x100..0x11C is accepted.

points.title: Interrupt output rises
points.condition: o_intr_timer_expired is 1 and was 0 at the previous edge.

points.title: Interrupt output falls
points.condition: o_intr_timer_expired is 0 and was 1 at the previous edge.

points.title: INTR_STATE W1C write while interrupt asserted
points.condition: A write to 0x104 with mask[0]=1 and data[0]=1 is accepted while o_intr_timer_expired=1.

points.title: INTR_TEST write of 1
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x108 with data[0]=1 is accepted.

points.title: Compare write while timer active
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x118 or 0x11C is accepted while CTRL.active_0 is set according to accepted writes.

points.title: Timer activated
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x004 with data[0]=1 is accepted while the timer was inactive.

points.title: Timer deactivated while active
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x004 with data[0]=0 is accepted while the timer was active.

points.title: CFG0 written with nonzero prescale
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x10C with data[11:0]!=0 is accepted.

points.title: TIMER_V_UPPER written to all ones near 2^64
points.condition: A full-word write to 0x114 with data=0xFFFFFFFF is accepted.

points.title: A-channel stall of 3 or more cycles
points.condition: i_a_valid=1 and o_a_ready=0 for the third or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: D-channel back-pressure of 3 or more cycles
points.condition: o_d_valid=1 and i_d_ready=0 for the third or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: Request accepted with another outstanding
points.condition: A request is accepted while at least one earlier request has no D beat yet.

points.title: Reset released after activity
points.condition: First edge with rst_ni=1 after a reset where, before reset, a request was outstanding, a response was pending or the timer was active.

points.title: Short reset window of at most 2 cycles
points.condition: First edge with rst_ni=1 after a reset that lasted 1 or 2 edges.

points.title: Request at highest register-space word 0x1FC
points.condition: A request with address 0x1FC is accepted.
